Subject: RE: HS code review — BL 12062678

Good morning team,

We reviewed the commercial invoice and supporting docs. The current description references table-top electronics; HS appears to be in the 85 series. For exhibits, HS 9503 could be appropriate but only if the shipment clearly meets "exhibition" use and the invoice reflects non-commercial sale/exhibit status.

To clear under 9503 we need one of the following certified documents:
1) Letter from Brightline Events confirming items are temporary exhibition displays and will be re-exported (on company letterhead), OR
2) Manufacturer declaration stating goods are "exhibition display units" and listing materials/weights, OR
3) Temporary admission carnet (unlikely at this late stage).

If none of the above are available, customs may require full import entry and duties. Time is tight for the 12:00 staging cutoff. Please send the amended commercial invoice (showing HS 9503) and any supporting letter ASAP.

Regards,
Liang Chen
Global Customs Broker
